items.name: Eastern Europe

items.name: Northern Nigeria Belt
items.note: Sustained violence against rural Christian communities. Prayer and displacement needs. Editorial watch, sourced from ministry and open reports.

news.headline: Rural congregations disrupted; local protection remains thin.
Partners request prayer and emergency displacement aid.

items.note: Conflict pressure on churches and Christian relief sites in northern Myanmar.

news.headline: Displacement camps continue to need medical and food aid.
